prompt: Jade races Orange around the block
title: Block Race, Block Race
irony: Orange runs to win alone, but the race is won when he slows down to finish side by side with Jade.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Yellow waves flags on the sunny street as Jade and Orange lace up at the corner.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Jade wants to race Dad around the block and grabs his hand while Orange shouts for one more lap.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares Jade she cannot beat her speedy dad, so Orange agrees to a full block race.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street chants block race as Jade and Orange take their marks at the corner.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Orange sprints ahead and yells faster while Jade trips on her loose shoe and Green shouts pacing facts.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Jade's juice spills across the road and Orange slips in it, and both giggle by Yellow's porch.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The whole street chants block race as Jade and Orange dust off and line up again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Orange sits on the curb with Copper and sees that pushing too hard steals the fun.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Orange decides to slow down and run beside Jade, and Jade cheers him back to the line.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: They rerun the last stretch side by side as Orange sings they win by finishing together.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They chant block race past Yellow's flags and walk home hand in hand, and they plan tomorrow's slow run.
